# `silk/native_resolver`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

Selected synchronous libc host resolution with one affine result-chain owner.

## When to use

Install NativeSystemResolver at a native application edge when blocking system DNS/NSS is
acceptable. Portable code should depend only on the Resolver service.

## Details

A deadline-free domain request makes exactly one getaddrinfo call and copies a finite result.
Every successful non-null chain is owned immediately and freed exactly once on every later exit.

## Gotchas

NativeSystemResolver rejects every domain deadline before observable work. Once getaddrinfo is
entered it has no cancellation, timeout, scheduler-parking, elapsed-time, or memory bound.
On unsupported targets or no-libc profiles, reached construction or resolution produces a
compile-time error. Unused imports remain available.

Import as `NativeSystemResolver` with `import silk.native_resolver { NativeSystemResolver }`.

Public declarations: 1.
